newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez repeats Frere welcome on board - report.
newsitem.headline: Suez repeats Frere welcome on board - report.

text.p: Compagnie de Suez Chairman Gerard Mestrallet repeated he would welcome Belgian businessman Albert Frere on the board of Suez and hopes he will take the necessary steps to achieve that end, financial daily La Tribune Desfosses reported on Monday.
"If Albert Frere could raise (his stake in Suez) to about five percent, I would be happy," Mestrallet said in an interview with the paper.
"His presence on the board of Compagnie de Suez... would be desirable for a company like ours."
Frere acquired a 2.9 percent stake in Suez from Elf Aquitaine, and was reported by financial daily L'Agefi on October 23 to have taken another one percent from French insurer UAP.
Mestrallet said in an interview with the Financial Times on October 24 that he hoped to see Frere on the board of Suez soon.
Frere controls the Belgian holding company Groupe Bruxelles Lambert.
